messages:
ashley: Quick proposal: emit lightweight 'cost_window' summaries plus explicit 'commit_marker' events on the metering topic so the billing reconciler has a durable checkpoint to close windows across regions. sketch attached below.

vik: interesting. how does this play with the compacted ledgers we already have?

ashley: intent is to leave per-request 'usage' events alone. add a second stream 'cost_window' with windowed aggregates and a 'commit_marker' when all partitions ack the ledger for that window. avoids heavy cross-joins during final reconciliation.

mike: two operational concerns: 1) stable ids for window summaries so recomputes are idempotent 2) late-arriving usage that should update a closed window

ashley: for stable id: checkpoint_id = sha1(window_start + tenant_id + topology_version). late arrivals become 'correction' events with same checkpoint_id; reconciler applies corrections when they arrive.

sara: audit question: do we keep raw usage forever or rely on summary + corrections for audits? huge retention tradeoff.

mike: pragmatic approach: raw usage retention short (30d), summaries retained longer (1y), commit_markers immutable for forensic trace. balances storage and auditability.

ashley: example messages (inline) — usage events stay as-is. cost_window looks like: ```{type: cost_window, checkpoint_id: ck_20250301_10_t42_v3, tenant_id: t42, window_start: 2025-03-01T10:00:00Z, window_end: 2025-03-01T10:05:00Z, tokens_total:125000, breakdown:[prompt:80000,completion:45000], derived_at:2025-03-01T10:05:02Z}``` and commit_marker: ```{type: commit_marker, checkpoint_id: ck_20250301_10_t42_v3, window_start:..., window_end:..., parts_ack:[us-west-1,eu-central-1], signature:...}```

vik: perf note: partition cost_window by tenant+checkpoint_id. corrections folding is local reduce. define merge function: fold by checkpoint_id, apply corrections in timestamp order, keep last_correction_ts. emit tombstone when superseded.

mike: agree. define retention policy for corrections; drop if older than retention cutoff. also we need a deterministic merge to avoid reconciliation drift.

sara: operational flow: reconciler watches commit_marker sequence per-tenant and only finalizes invoice windows when marker seen from all expected partitions. what if markers are missing?

ashley: fallback: after grace window emit 'partial_commit' with partitions_missing and kick off async repair. surface alert in Console with debugging hints (missing partition id, last_seq, offset).

billing-bot: sim summary: prototype with 100 tenants reduced cross-region finalize time by ~82%. link: https://ci.internal/sim/1765558888

mike: nice. next steps: 1) RFC with exact schema + merge semantics (owner: ashley) 2) prototype deploy to staging (owner: vik) 3) reconciliation test harness for partial_commit scenarios (owner: sara)

ashley: i'll draft RFC today and include migration plan for older compacted ledgers (options: backfill vs translate-on-read). will ping eng-qa for sim window.

vik: :thumbsup: if RFC by EOD i can reserve staging slot next week.

sara: add compliance checklist item: validate audit exports after migration (owner: sara).

mike: keeping summaries lightweight should help ops adopt this approach. thanks everyone.

ashley: marked follow-up on eng-platform board and added owners.
